summary: Owned units s0023–s0044 contain no births, deaths, or ages. Yin Hao’s Yangzhou letter is correctly bounded on or after AD 346 (晉穆帝永和二年 appointment/acceptance), and his northern campaign plus Yao Xiang’s victory are annal-backed to 永和八年–九年 (AD 352–353; the 山桑 rout stays in AD 353). Huan Wen’s feud is dated in that campaign context, not from later reception. Ma Midi’s own 初平三年八月 mission converts to AD 192 and is not dated from Wang Xizhi’s later quotation. Shang Ziping is only a retrospective exemplar, with empty active hints. Wang Dao’s undated invitation is a genuine uncertainty window across his Eastern Jin premiership (晉元帝建武元年 / AD 317 to 晉成帝咸康五年 / AD 339), while a narrower 丞相-title reading of 338–339 remains possible inside that window. Claim-153 is incorrect: its 351 start is a later 會稽 nianpu inference, not an annal or chapter date for 時殷浩與桓溫不協, and the same phrase is dated 352–353 on claim-171 and claim-957.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi accepts Guard-the-Army, becomes Kuaiji administrator, and writes while Yin Hao and Huan Wen are at odds.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Wang Xizhi. The sourceDate 時殷浩與桓溫不協 is the same phrase claim-171 and claim-957 convert to AD 352–353 from 晉穆帝永和八年–九年. The 351 start is a later 右軍年譜 inference that 會稽內史 began in 永和七年; neither this chapter nor the Mu Di annals date 既拜護軍 or 會稽內史. The closed 351–353 interval therefore invents a precise first endpoint and narrates a span of office plus letters rather than uncertainty about one event. Annals place Hao’s northern operations in 永和八年九月 (next 泗口) and Yao Xiang’s rout in 永和九年冬十月; the 永和 month table puts that 十月 first day at 11/13, still AD 353 (十二月 begins 354/1/11). Repair should drop 351 or replace the interval with the annal-backed 352–353 campaign window, without using Lanting or later commemoration as a life date.

evidence.quote: 羲之既拜護軍，又苦求宣城郡，不許，乃以為右軍將軍、會稽內史。
時殷浩與桓溫不協

itemChecks.event: Chancellor Wang Dao once tried to bring Wang Xizhi into office, an undated attempt Wang later recalled.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Wang Dao, for one invitation whose year is unknown. 王丞相時 names his premiership as the bound. In 晉元帝建武元年 (AD 317; era 317年三月–318年三月) he is already 都督中外諸軍事、驃騎將軍; in 晉成帝咸康五年七月庚申 he dies as 丞相 (咸康 335–342; year 5 = 339; that 七月 begins 8/21, so 庚申 stays in AD 339). Formal 丞相 is only 咸康四年六月–五年, a competing narrower reading; 王丞相 is the conventional address for his whole Eastern Jin chief-ministership, and 由來尚矣 implies the refusal was not confined to 338–339. The 317–339 window is uncertainty about that one event, not activity throughout a dynasty. 建武 is a repeated era name and is here 晉元帝, not 漢光武帝 or 後趙石虎.

evidence.quote: 直王丞相時果欲內吾，誓不許之，手跡猶存，由來尚矣

itemChecks.event: Yin Hao, as Inspector of Yang, writes urging Wang Xizhi to accept the Guard-the-Army appointment.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Yin Hao’s letter under the title 揚州刺史. 晉穆帝紀 永和二年三月丙子 appoints him 建武將軍、揚州刺史; his biography says 自三月至七月，乃受拜焉. 永和 is 晉穆帝 345–356 (not 漢順帝 or 後秦), year 2 = AD 346; that 三月 begins 4/8, so the appointment stays in 346. He holds Yang until 永和十年二月 (354). onOrAfter 346 is the correct one-sided bound and does not invent a second endpoint or claim the letter was written in 346. The letter precedes 既拜護軍 and is not the later northern campaign.

evidence.quote: 揚州刺史殷浩素雅重之，勸使應命

itemChecks.event: Late-Han Grand Tutor Ma Midi is sent to console and pacify the lands east of the passes.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Ma Midi’s own late-Han mission, not Wang Xizhi’s later quotation. 後漢書獻帝紀 初平三年秋七月庚子 he becomes 太傅; 八月 遣日磾及太僕趙岐，持節尉撫天下. 初平 is 漢獻帝 190–193, year 3 = AD 192. The 初平 month table puts 七月 first day at 7/28 and 八月 at 8/26 of 192 (閏八月 9/25), so the dispatch stays in AD 192. Year precision matches a source without a day. Pre-1582 table dates follow the Julian convention used by Academia Sinica; the proleptic-Gregorian year of August 192 is still 192. This is not a reception date and is not used as Wang’s activity.

evidence.quote: 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen is at odds with Yin Hao when Wang Xizhi writes that the realm needs inner and outer peace.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Huan Wen’s contemporaneous feud, not a later honor. Chapter 80 places 時殷浩與桓溫不協 immediately before 及浩將北伐. Hao’s northern operations are 永和八年九月 次泗口 and 永和九年冬十月 the Yao Xiang rout (AD 352–353). The feud began earlier (浩傳 after the Shu campaign: 於是與溫頗相疑貳), and they were still at odds in 352–353; the interval dates the chapter’s campaign-context moment rather than the first year of the quarrel. Huan Wen is living; this is not retrospective reception.

evidence.quote: 時殷浩與桓溫不協

itemChecks.event: Yao Xiang defeats Yin Hao after Hao goes ahead with the northern campaign.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Yao Xiang’s victory. 晉穆帝紀 永和九年冬十月：浩進次山桑，姚襄為前鋒，襄叛，反擊浩. 永和九年 of 晉穆帝 = AD 353. The month table puts 十月 first day at 11/13 and 十二月 at 354/1/11, so the October battle stays in AD 353. Year precision is right for a chapter sentence without a month. This is Yao Xiang’s own action, not a later commemoration.

evidence.quote: 浩遂行果為姚襄所敗

itemChecks.event: Yin Hao, at odds with Huan Wen, ignores Wang Xizhi, campaigns north, and is defeated by Yao Xiang.
itemChecks.reason: The dated owner is Yin Hao. 永和八年九月 he 帥眾北伐，次泗口; 永和九年冬十月 Yao Xiang routs him at 山桑. That is one northern enterprise across AD 352–353, not activity throughout a dynasty. 復圖再舉 after the October 353 defeat can still fall in 353 (dismissal is 永和十年二月 / 354). The earlier 不協 is a standing condition during these years, not a second undocumented life date.
